Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols, in an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) network, comprising: for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over __at least a portion of__ the carrier; and for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over __at least a portion of__ the carrier.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over __at least a portion of__ the carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers distributed over __at least a portion of__ the carrier.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): A superframe generator in a base station in an OFDM network, comprising a preamble generator operable to generate a superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols for a superframe by (i) for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over __at least a portion of__ the carrier, and (ii) for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over __at least a portion of__ the carrier.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over __at least a portion of__ the carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern.
